lines.trans: Louis, are you still working in the kitchen?
Yes, I am making delicate chocolate cream.
It seems to you that he is indifferent to everything.
Then you realize you know little about him.
Louis, do not take offense at my silly words.

words.gloss: to take offence, to be hurt

lines.trans: I was completely wrong about you.
Nothing terrible, Max, I understand.
Cooking such desserts is really difficult.
Many think that these are simple sweets.
But confectionery art requires great patience.
Now I respect your work very much.
Thank you, Max, try this fresh dessert.
How many discoveries still lie ahead for us.

words.gloss: to lie ahead, be in store

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: Искусство войны = The Art of War

examples.trans: Read The Art of War, by Sun Tzu!
She loves modern art very much.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me
как вы знаете = as you know

examples.text: Кондитер взбил нежный крем для торта.
examples.trans: The pastry chef whipped delicate cream for the cake.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: многие из вас = many of you

examples.text: У многих из вас появились сомнения.
examples.trans: Many of you have begun to have doubts.
Many people think the same way.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Не волнуйся ты насчёт этого Мишкина.
examples.trans: Don't you worry about that Mishkin.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Я могу быть очень нежным и ласковым.
examples.trans: I can be very gentle and affectionate.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

обижаться.gloss: to take offence, to be hurt

meanings.en: to take offence, to get upset

examples.trans: Don't be offended by my words.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: beginning of an event or venue

examples.trans: Since the opening of the restaurant.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: in a genuine and real manner
понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

meanings.note: short form: ты прав = you're right

предстоять.gloss: to lie ahead, be in store

meanings.en: to lie ahead, be in store, be forthcoming

examples.trans: Many discoveries lie ahead for us.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.trans: He seems like an indifferent person.
Do you think that's really possible?
It's realistic to do that in a day.

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: the capacity to accept or tolerate delay or difficulty
a bit formal; 'биржа труда' = job centre

examples.trans: The job centre is over there.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.
